title: Collections Desk Note — Payment Arrangement Lines on the Electric Service by Rate Schedule Bill and the Late Charge
content:
A Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) record on a service account bills its installments, and after a default its balance, on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule bill. In figuring the late-charged amount of the most recent bill, the arrangement lines of that bill are left out according to the status of the account's payment arrangement:

| Payment arrangement of the service account | Left out of the late-charged amount |
|---|---|
| Defaulted, with an ended date less than twelve whole months before the current date | The bill's arrangement balance rebill lines |
| Active | The bill's arrangement installment lines |
| Any other case | No arrangement line |

The lines left out are taken off the bill's usage and program charge lines in figuring the late-charged amount, which is never less than zero.

### Cases (hypothetical arrangements)

| Arrangement status and ended date | Lines on the bill | Left out |
|---|---|---|
| Defaulted, ended five months ago | Balance rebill line $412.00 | $412.00 |
| Defaulted, ended fourteen months ago | Balance rebill line $412.00 | Nothing |
| Active | Installment line $85.00 | $85.00 |
| Completed | Installment line $85.00 | Nothing |

### Points of reading

- The status and the ended date are read from the payment arrangement record of the same service account.
- An active arrangement leaves out its installment lines only; a defaulted arrangement within the twelve months leaves out its balance rebill lines only.
